boundary_rule: Onset: 20 px aperture threshold; stable: 5 frames within 5 px of hold, median distance <25 px; 12-frame pre-onset, 20-frame post-stable, capped before withdrawal

tail_trim.reason: Sustained terminal aperture re-opening after stable hold
tail_trim.rule: Last-two-frame median >=3 px above minimum 3-point median after stable; trim at first two smoothed points >minimum+1.5 px; retain at least 3 stable frames
